summary: Iteration 6 — Google sign-in button restoration (vendor-independent GSI). Verified Google button visible on /login and /register with correct labels ('Sign in with Google' / 'Sign up with Google'), 'OR' divider above button, click triggers sonner toast about REACT_APP_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID not configured without navigation. Backend POST /api/v1/auth/google returns 503 with 'not configured' detail when GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID unset. Regressions clean: /auth/register+login+me works, /generate/providers returns vendor-neutral list (openrouter/gemini/groq/huggingface/ollama), no emergentintegrations in backend, no 'emergent' string in frontend/src, index.html clean + GSI script tag present. Fixed one CRITICAL bug: Login.jsx had orphaned JSX after the component's closing brace causing webpack compilation failure (whole frontend was broken).
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx was broken with leftover JSX after `export default function Login` closing brace (lines 126-137 orphaned) — webpack compilation error. Fixed by properly integrating divider + GoogleButton inside the form (matching Register.jsx pattern). Main agent must be careful with str_replace edits — the previous edit clearly appended new content instead of replacing the 'coming soon' block cleanly.

GoogleButton.jsx uses window.google.accounts.id.prompt() which is deprecated for new sign-ups (One Tap only shows to eligible users) — consider google.accounts.oauth2 code client or renderButton() for production; acceptable for MVP since Client ID unset.
/api/v1/auth/google endpoint uses tokeninfo REST hit (adds ~200-500ms). Fine for SPA but google-auth library's id_token.verify_oauth2_token is faster and offline-verifies signature.
test_credentials: Fresh users registered at runtime with TEST_it6_* prefix
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google button restoration is complete + verified. Real OAuth flow cannot be tested without GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/REACT_APP_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID env vars. Vendor-independence maintained.
rca of the issue: User's original bug ('why google account button not showing') was caused by iteration-5 Emergent-cleanup removing the GoogleButton and the Emergent OAuth handler. Main agent's fix reintroduces a vendor-independent GSI-based button + backend endpoint. However the str_replace edit on Login.jsx duplicated JSX outside the component function causing SyntaxError and blocking the entire frontend from compiling. Testing agent fixed the Login.jsx JSX structure and verified everything works end-to-end.
